summary: Coordinate security risks, control ownership and reporting in five days. Review the foundation-level information security management course.
lede: Information security management coordinates security responsibilities, risks and controls across a program. For security analysts, IT operations leads and risk coordinators, this training covers building a program baseline, prioritizing information risks and assigning control owners and safeguard actions. It also addresses mapping incident escalation roles and preparing a management review brief to track actions and communicate progress.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who coordinate information security work, maintain controls or report risks and progress across business and technology teams.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace information systems and routine information handling is useful. No coding or programming is required.
